sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:3

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:3:1
items.html: Although they are seven kings, they are ten: That is, not only do the ZAT, which are HGT NHYM of Katnut, likewise include ten Sefirot, meaning ten Sefirot in which each one contains HGT NHYM, but there was also in them a coupling of Gadlut in which there is actual GAR, that is, HBD as well, as written further on.
